LanguageData.FB_TheCallBelow.label: The Call Below
LanguageData.FB_TheCallBelow.scenario.name: The Call Below
LanguageData.FB_TheCallBelow.description:
For weeks, one of your people has felt a pull from somewhere below the world. It was never a clear voice, only a constant pressure behind the thoughts: patient, insistent, and impossible to ignore. In the end, the only way to quiet it was to follow it. Taking two companions and a bundle of expedition supplies, you set down at the place that kept calling in your sleep.

The soil here feels wrong. The air tastes damp and organic. And not long after you arrive, the ground answers for itself.

Starts with 3 colonists. A flesh burrow opens shortly after the game begins, granting early access to the undercolony.

LanguageData.FB_HungryMoon.label: Hungry Moon
LanguageData.FB_HungryMoon.scenario.name: Hungry Moon
LanguageData.FB_HungryMoon.description:
A vast living moon has reached this planet hungry and intact. It does not land. It does not negotiate. It opens its inner flesh, creates three naked extensions of its will, and prepares to feed from orbit.

There is no surface colony. Your first shelter is the moon itself: a breathing cavern around a folded celestial umbilicus, a reserve of hemogel, a few bodies to harvest, and enough fleshbeasts to begin shaping the invasion below.

This is a casual introductory scenario meant for learning the flesh moon, not a strict challenge.

Starts with 3 naked colonists on the flesh moon. Each starts with 4 random flesh genes and flesh-colony acceptance. The moon reserve contains 10000 hemogel. Research through celestial budding is completed. No ordinary supplies are provided.
